summary: Corrects an omission in the registry of object identifiers assigned by the PKIX working group. RFC 7299 documented identifiers under an IANA-allocated arc, but a small number assigned in RFC 4212 were left out. This document updates RFC 7299 to include them.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 9158 corrects an omission in a registry of PKIX object identifiers. It records two identifiers and explains how future entries can be added.

questions: what is the pkix object identifier registry
what does rfc 9158 add to rfc 7299
subtitle: Adds omitted PKIX object identifiers to an IANA registry.

tldr.problem: RFC 7299 omitted a small number of object identifiers assigned in RFC 4212.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 9158 creates an IANA subregistry for the relevant arc, lists the two identifiers, and sets a Specification Required policy for future entries.
tldr.outcome: RFC 9158 updates RFC 7299 and the unit metadata lists no later replacement.

today: RFC 9158 is Informational and updates RFC 7299. The unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates RFC 9158.

sections.title: The Omitted Identifiers
sections.content: After the PKIX Working Group closed, RFC 7299 described object identifiers assigned in the arc allocated to that group. A small number assigned in RFC 4212 were missing from that description. This RFC corrects the omission and establishes an IANA registry for the relevant arc.
sections.plainLanguage: A previous registry description left out a small number of identifiers. This RFC adds them to the record.

sections.title: The New Subregistry
sections.content:
IANA created the SMI Security for PKIX CRMF Registration Controls for Alternate Certificate Formats subregistry. It is under the SMI Numbers registry and covers the arc 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.5.1.7. Its initial entries are decimal 1, id-acTemplate, and decimal 2, id-openPGPCertTemplateExt.

Future updates follow the Specification Required policy. New values should relate to PKIX Working Group work and support alternate certificate formats with PKIX CMP or CMC.
sections.plainLanguage: The new list starts with two identifiers. A reviewer checks that future entries relate to the specified PKIX certificate-management work.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC says that populating the IANA registry raises no new security considerations. The protocols that specify the registered values include the security considerations for their use.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC adds registry entries and says it creates no new security considerations.
